floorPlans.label: Deyaar ParkFive Elm original floor plans
floorPlans.introduction: Browse the complete Elm sheets published by Deyaar, including the original unit-position keys.
floorPlans.note: Published totals include exterior areas. This linked PDF shows first-floor layouts. Repeated types have distinct drawings or unit-position keys and retain their physical page numbers. The 1 BR 1At and 2 BR 2At printed totals differ from component sums by 1 sq ft. Confirm the specific home’s contractual area.

review.gallery: 9 native-resolution renders from the dedicated Elm brochure. Shared community amenities are identified in the captions. Two actual photographs come from Deyaar’s shared Elm, Ember and Neem update and retain that group scope. The source gives no visible inspection date.
review.location: Physical page 11 marks the shared ParkFive community. It publishes 15 minutes to Dubai Exhibition Centre/Expo City and 25 minutes to Dubai airport. The map and text were visually checked. The page uses named directions because a verified building entrance point was unavailable.
review.floorPlans: 16 complete original plan sheets. Each type and printed total was visually checked. This linked PDF shows first-floor layouts. Repeated types have distinct drawings or unit-position keys and retain their physical page numbers. The 1 BR 1At and 2 BR 2At printed totals differ from component sums by 1 sq ft.
